pull.q: This tiny but handy module connects the USB A connector to the +5V bus on the Intellijel TPS series powered busboards.

quotes.t: Allowing 1A or more of current to be supplied to USB devices such as lamps, phone chargers, and usb powered musical devices.
Power only, no data. It plugs into the two-pin USB header on an Intellijel TPS bus board, so it needs a case that has one. Intellijel 1U format, not Pulp Logic.

reviews.title: Intellijel USB Power 1U — specs and racks

blurb.en: A USB-A socket on a 4HP 1U tile, fed from the case's +5V: somewhere to plug a gooseneck lamp, charge a phone, or power a small USB synth or controller without another wall adapter. It carries power only, no data. It connects to the two-pin USB header on an Intellijel TPS bus board, so it suits Intellijel cases and others with that header. Intellijel 1U format; not Pulp Logic.
blurb.fi: USB-A-liitin 4HP:n 1U-tiilellä, syötettynä kotelon +5V:stä: paikka johon kytkeä joutsenkaulalamppu, ladata puhelin tai syöttää virtaa pienelle USB-syntikalle tai ohjaimelle ilman yhtä uutta verkkolaitetta. Vain virta, ei dataa. Se kytketään Intellijelin TPS-virtakiskon kaksinapaiseen USB-liittimeen, joten se sopii Intellijelin koteloihin ja muihin joissa tuo liitin on. Intellijelin 1U-formaatti; ei Pulp Logic.
blurb.sv: Ett USB-A-uttag på en 4HP 1U-bricka, matat från lådans +5V: någonstans att koppla in en svanhalslampa, ladda en telefon eller driva en liten USB-synt eller kontroller utan ännu en nätadapter. Enbart ström, ingen data. Den ansluts till den tvåpoliga USB-kontakten på en Intellijel TPS-busskort, så den passar Intellijel-lådor och andra med den kontakten. Intellijels 1U-format; inte Pulp Logic.
